dict.string: Loop Just is a macOS window management utility with configurable keyboard shortcuts for moving, resizing, and arranging windows.
Loop Just periodically checks if a newer version of the app is available. You can disable these automatic software update checks in the About tab of Loop Just's settings.
If you deny these connections, you will not be notified about new versions of Loop Just.
Loop Just downloads software updates from GitHub if a newer version is available.
If you deny these connections, Loop Just will not be able to install software updates by iteslf.
